title: UPDATE: Weekend roundup: The dark side to the big drop in credit-card debt | The AT&T aftermath | Anti-FAANG stock picks
text:
By Philip van Doorn, MarketWatch
Debt, a coming wave of media consolidation and various ways to select investments
MarketWatch rounds up 10 of its most interesting topics over the past week.
1. A big reduction in card debt
Americans reduced their credit-card debt by more than $40 billion during the first quarter. But there's more to this story, and some if it isn't pretty (http://www.marketwatch.com/story/americans-just-paid-off-a-ton-of-credit-card-debt-but-heres-the-bad-news-2018-06-12).
2. Court decision sets up media merger mania
Telecom companies and other pay-TV providers need to diversify or face a long, slow decline as consumers find cheaper alternatives. This week's court approval of AT&T's(T)$85 billion deal to acquire Time Warner (http://www.marketwatch.com/story/tv-telecom-and-media-companies-sluggish-sales-numbers-create-an-urge-to-merge-2018-06-13) was followed by Comcast's(CMCSA)bid for assets that 21st Century Fox (http://www.marketwatch.com/story/uk-opens-door-to-fox-comcast-bidding-war-for-sky-2018-06-05)(FOXA) (FOXA) had previously agreed to sell to Disney(DIS). Here are the numbers behind the media industry consolidation (http://www.marketwatch.com/story/tv-telecom-and-media-companies-sluggish-sales-numbers-create-an-urge-to-merge-2018-06-13).
3. An anti-FAANG portfolio
You likely own some if not all of the FAANG stocks (Facebook(FB), Amazon.com(AMZN), Apple(AAPL), Netflix(NFLX) and Google holding company Alphabet(GOOGL) (GOOGL)), either directly or through a fund. But broaden your horizons. Brian Milligan of the Ave Maria Growth Fund offers up six companies that can escape the "Amazon effect" and perform well over the long term (http://www.marketwatch.com/story/these-6-stocks-help-you-build-an-anti-faang-portfolio-that-will-beat-the-amazon-effect-2018-06-11).
4. Fact-checking on trade policy
It appears U.S. tariffs on China and reciprocal ones from Beijing are about to become reality (http://www.marketwatch.com/story/trump-announces-china-tariffs-says-us-will-pursue-more-if-china-retaliates-2018-06-15), unless President Trump announces a negotiating breakthrough. But some of the tariff discussions aren't backed by facts or are oversimplified (http://www.marketwatch.com/story/trump-gets-it-backwards-when-he-says-the-us-is-a-piggy-bank-that-everybodys-robbing-2018-06-12). Michael J. Hicks compares misinformation tied to tariff talk to the misinformed fear of vaccines (http://www.marketwatch.com/story/fight-over-trade-policy-is-like-the-fight-over-vaccines-theres-a-lot-of-wrong-information-2018-06-12).
5. Maybe Italy never should have adopted the euro
Problems in Italy may lead to a crisis for the common currency (http://www.marketwatch.com/story/italy-never-should-have-joined-the-euro-and-the-ecb-cant-rescue-it-from-its-next-crisis-2018-06-11).
6. You don't have to wait for the Federal Reserve to earn yields of 5% or more
Here are various higher-yielding investments sorted by your level of risk tolerance (http://www.marketwatch.com/story/investors-can-get-5-plus-yields-without-waiting-for-more-fed-interest-rate-increases-2018-06-14).
7. Netflix and Minecraft
Minecraft is one of the most popular videogames, although "Fortnite" may have taken over in your home recently (http://www.marketwatch.com/story/want-to-make-money-off-the-fortnite-video-game-buy-this-stock-2018-05-22). Now Netflix(NFLX) is jumping into the fray with a streaming Minecraft product that it says isn't really a game (http://www.marketwatch.com/story/netflix-joins-with-videogame-company-on-minecraft-series-but-dont-call-it-a-game-2018-06-13).
8. An overpriced cloud IPO
Shares of Avalara , a maker of cloud-based tax software, rocketed on their debut (http://www.marketwatch.com/story/avalaras-stocks-rockets-on-debut-after-ipo-prices-above-expected-range-2018-06-15). But this analysis concludes this sizzling IPO is overpriced (http://www.marketwatch.com/story/avalaras-ipo-looks-hot-but-its-overpriced-2018-06-15).
More on cloud services:10 cloud stocks suitable for long-term stock investors (http://www.marketwatch.com/story/this-30-second-change-to-your-computer-settings-is-the-easiest-way-to-stop-hackers-2018-06-12).
9. Do this now or pay someone to do it for you
Here's a simple change you can make to your computers to stop hackers from breaking in (http://www.marketwatch.com/story/this-30-second-change-to-your-computer-settings-is-the-easiest-way-to-stop-hackers-2018-06-12).
10. World Cup party
Soccer fans have plenty of World Cup action to enjoy this weekend. When you're not watching, read this:
-- How NOT to bet during the World Cup (http://www.marketwatch.com/story/how-not-to-bet-during-the-world-cup-according-to-behavioral-science-2018-06-12)
-- Here are 10 players to watch at the 2018 World Cup (http://www.marketwatch.com/story/here-are-10-players-to-watch-at-the-2018-world-cup-2018-06-08)
-- Watch these World Cup players cash in afterward (http://www.marketwatch.com/story/watch-these-soccer-players-in-the-world-cup-and-how-they-cash-in-afterward-2018-06-12)
-- U.S., Canada and Mexico to co-host 2026 World Cup (http://www.marketwatch.com/story/us-canada-and-mexico-to-co-host-2026-world-cup-2018-06-13)
